signature.name: VTask.banana
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> (u v : α) -> (edgeSet : Set β) -> Graph α β

conventions.statement: When edgeSet is empty, VTask.banana u v ∅ has vertex set {u, v} and no edges, and equals the no-edge graph on {u, v}.
conventions.note: The graph is still valid; it simply has no edges.

conventions.statement: When u equals v, the vertex set collapses to a singleton and every edge in edgeSet becomes a loop at u rather than a link between two distinct vertices.
conventions.note: IsLoopAt holds for every edge in this case; IsNonloopAt fails for every edge.

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β), VTask.banana u v edgeSet = VTask.banana v u edgeSet

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α), VTask.banana u v (∅ : Set β) = Graph.noEdge {u, v} β

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β) (e : β) (x : α), (VTask.banana u v edgeSet).Inc e x ↔ e ∈ edgeSet ∧ (x = u ∨ x = v)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β) (x y : α), (VTask.banana u v edgeSet).Adj x y ↔ edgeSet.Nonempty ∧ s(x, y) = s(u, v)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β) (e : β) (x : α), (VTask.banana u v edgeSet).IsLoopAt e x ↔ e ∈ edgeSet ∧ x = u ∧ u = v

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β) (e : β) (x : α), (VTask.banana u v edgeSet).IsNonloopAt e x ↔ e ∈ edgeSet ∧ (x = u ∨ x = v) ∧ u ≠ v

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β), edgeSet.Nonempty → (VTask.banana u v edgeSet).Adj u v

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (β : Type*) (u v : α) (x y : α), ¬(VTask.banana u v (∅ : Set β)).Adj x y
